title: Radiant Nuclear header
description: A frosted bar floating 12px in from the top and sides of the window: a mark and a bold caps wordmark on the left, two or three small caps links on the right. Over the first screen it is an almost opaque warm white; within the first ~420px of scrolling the glass thins to a faint veil over whatever passes beneath.
notes: takes no height: it floats over the first section (the hero starts at the top of the page under it)
the glass fade is CSS scroll-driven (page scroll); without support the bar stays almost opaque
no phone menu: the links stay inline at every width, so keep them short
name: radiantnuclear-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the wordmark, set in bold capitals next to the mark

props.name: logo
props.description: the small mark before the wordmark (an svg, img or lucide icon)

props.name: links
props.description: the links on the right, shown in small capitals (two or three short ones)
